description: Search TripAdvisor locations (restaurants, attractions, hotels) by name. Returns matches with a location id for the detail tools, plus pagination. Returns slim summaries by default; pass view:"full" for the whole records.

geo_name.description: City, town, or country name to scope the search

locale.description: Preferred locales for localized fields, in priority order (e.g. ["en","es"])

query.description: Text to search location names for

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact returns the slim projection where one exists and strips image URLs elsewhere; "full" returns TripAdvisor's whole records.

name: ta_search_locations
